title: Where to get started?
author: PuzzledPuzzle0
selftext:
Hello Everybody, 

currently i am working on a game project in Unity and i use BeziAi as AI coding assistant it works good but I wonder what other (maybe better) workflows are out there. I read a lot of post of "made entire with claude" but I always wonder if it even did the Art or Animations or VFX? My game is a 2D game and i tried AI image generation before and it looked always okayish but thats it (with free tools). I thought about buying access to an AI tool for pixelart but not sure yet. 

BeziAi works good for Unity but i get that i am using models there with an provider inbetween and not the model itself so i am also unsure if subscribing to an claude or gbt model would benefit me more then use something like bezi but I don't know how you would set it up in Unity so it can edit assets or build scenes and these things.

Are there some good guides or videos I can look into to learn more and improve my workflow? What are you using and how do you handle specific other things?

Thank you for your help

comments.author: EffectNo2152
comments.body:
my hermes stack is claude, astra, grok build, meta   
local qwen (old model)

basically claude hits it outta the park by itself but if i wanna make peripheral coding for my project say a sound editor or a 2d animation bone editor ill use the others all the way down to pushing it to my github, updating my launched game and organzing all my game into different branches on github and locally. im now using vite and hotreload to edit locally the chosen repo then push that if im happy with it.

you want a harness a container multiple agents and def your main agent should  
be one of these large commerical guys as they have  
agentic recursion built in already. 

take what i just said and show it to your AI
